S1.description: Agent fails to correctly parse, cross-reference, or reason over structured data. Picks wrong flight leg, wrong product variant, misidentifies the fastest/cheapest/max-spec option, or exchanges the wrong-color item.

S2.description: Agent calls the right tool but with wrong arguments. Primary failure modes: wrong payment method (credit card vs PayPal vs gift card), wrong item IDs in exchange/modify calls, wrong dates or flight legs passed to update_reservation.

S3.description: Agent completes some sub-tasks but silently drops others. Includes: cancelling entire order when user wanted specific items only, dropping secondary address changes or item modifications, confirming actions without executing tool calls.

S4.description: Agent executes actions without checking required preconditions. Cancels basic economy tickets without checking policy, issues compensation for non-delayed flights after user pressure, processes return to wrong payment method after user insists.

S5.description: Agent makes arithmetic errors in totals, refunds, or payment splits. Includes mismatched certificate + payment amounts, and confusing refund vs charge direction for price differences.

S6.description: Agent fails to find all relevant records or acts on wrong record. Stops at first matching order when multiple exist, cancels wrong reservation, or fails identity verification when user provides partial/indirect info.

S7.description: Agent completes the action correctly but fails to communicate required information. Omits refund amounts, product specification details, or timeline information the user explicitly asked for.

S8.description: Agent ignores if-then-else branches or calls wrong API for entity's current state. Uses return/exchange tools on pending orders instead of modify_pending_order, tries to exchange return-requested orders, calls modify on cancelled orders.
